name: Curtain Rod
instruction: Design a 3D model of a curtain rod. It should be a long, straight rod with decorative finials on both ends. Include mounting brackets for attaching it to a wall.

Shape accuracy: The object in the images is a curtain rod.
The rod is long and straight.
The finials at both ends are decorative.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The length of the rod is proportionate to the decorative finials.
The finials are appropriately sized relative to the rod.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The finials are correctly positioned at both ends of the rod.
The mounting brackets are placed at appropriate intervals along the rod.
The rod is straight and does not sag under its own weight.
Object distance and contact: The finials do not overlap with the rod.
The mounting brackets are securely attached to the rod.
There is no gap between the rod and the mounting brackets.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified attributes are represented in the design.
The design includes both decorative finials and mounting brackets.
